user_select.name: user_select
user_select.using:
exists (
        select 1 from workspace_member wm
        where wm.user_id = "app_user"."id"
          and wm.workspace_id = tenancy.workspace_id()
      )

workspace_member_unavailable_idx.name: workspace_member_unavailable_idx
workspace_member_unavailable_idx.where: "workspace_member"."unavailable_until" is not null and "workspace_member"."deleted_at" is null
